name: NGC 4144 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4144, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4144-hubble
story: We see this spiral galaxy edge-on, looking straight along its disk. Studies of its individual stars in Hubble images have traced a thick disk and a flattened halo of stars around it.

claims.text: NGC 4144 is an edge-on spiral galaxy
Photometry of individual stars in Hubble ACS/WFC and WFPC2 images found a thick disk and a halo
NGC 4144 was a target of a Hubble snapshot survey of nearby edge-on spiral galaxies
